text:
sophia_li: Heads-up: Candidate is Emiliano Ruiz, coming Wed 09:30-13:00 PT for an onsite loop. He requested a Spanish-language welcome packet, a Windows loaner with Docker + Python, and permission to connect his external NVMe for a short eval. Can we confirm please?

alan_v: Hiring manager here  Loop structure: 2 interviews + whiteboard + wrap. Spanish packet is great. Loaner should have `python3.9` and `docker` installed. NVMe allowed read-only.

mike_it: We have a Win10 loaner with an RTX 2070. I can image it with Python 3.9, Docker Desktop, and preload the `eval-model:v2` (1.9GB). Need to know if the eval requires internet or should be offline. Also we'll need the candidate's SSH pubkey to pre-create temp user.

facilities: I can reserve Conf G (floor 6) and mark it as "Spanish-speaking" on the front desk. Do we need parking validation or hotel courtesy?

sophia_li: Parking validation for 2 hours, and a courtesy hotel if arrival before 9pm. Dietary: lacto-ovo vegetarian, no shellfish. Single boxed meal please.

mike_it: Recommended: stage the model offline on internal registry to avoid internet dependency. I'll mount the NVMe read-only and sanitize it on arrival. Need candidate consent form signed.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Emiliano Ruiz  travel: Madrid. Prefers EUR reimbursement. Visa: not required. Email: e.ruiz@example.es. Requested Spanish-language visa support letter.

alan_v: Please add a short agenda and note about the language packet in the calendar invite. Also include transit directions (nearest metro) and how to get a visitor badge.

facilities: Conf G locked 09:00-13:30 for setup/teardown. Zoom link: https://zoom.company.com/j/444444444. Front desk will print badge with "Interviews - Spanish". Parking code `PT-88` for 2 hours.

sophia_li: Agenda (paste into invite):
``
09:00  setup + laptop check
09:30  Intro / Hiring mgr (Alan)
10:00  Tech interview A
10:45  Whiteboard (engineering)
11:30  Lunch + buffer
12:00  Wrap / recruiter next steps
``

mike_it: Imaging started. Will preload `eval-model:v2` to local mirror and disable outbound net on the loaner. Will bring a sanitized wired keyboard and power brick. Please collect NVMe consent from candidate before arrival.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Calendar invite created and sent to e.ruiz@example.es, Alan, Sophia, Mike. Invite ID: 1898765432-emru.

alan_v: :thumbsup: One more ask  can the invite include a short line about language preference and who to ask for at the desk ("Ask for Sofia at reception").

sophia_li: Added note and Spanish welcome packet attached. I'll follow up after I get the NVMe consent and the SSH key. Closing loop unless anything else pops up. Gracias! :es:
